title.zh: GPS 怎样定位：伪距与钟差
title.en: How GPS finds you: pseudoranges and clock bias

description.zh: 手机量信号走了多久，把自己的钟差当成未知数，多用一颗卫星把它解出来。
description.en: The phone times the signals and treats its own clock error as one more unknown, solved with one extra satellite.

zh: 手机怎么知道自己在哪
en: how does my phone know where I am

title.zh: 加速度计：弹簧上的检测质量
title.en: Accelerometer: a proof mass on a spring

description.zh: 加速度计量的是弹簧托住硅块的力，所以静止时读出重力、自由落体时读出零。
description.en: An accelerometer measures the force the springs need to hold a proof mass, so it reads gravity when still and zero in free fall.

zh: 手机怎么知道横屏竖屏
手机怎么知道哪边朝上
en: how does my phone know which way is up

description.zh: 把加速度积分两次得到位置，一个很小的零点偏差会按时间的平方放大，所以要用 GPS 校正。
description.en: Integrating acceleration twice turns a tiny bias into a position error that grows with time squared, so it must be corrected by GPS.

title.zh: 电容触摸屏与插值定位

description.zh: 手指改变电极网的电容，按相邻几根电极的读数加权平均，定位精度远细于电极间距。
description.en: A finger changes the capacitance of an electrode grid; weighting neighbouring electrodes locates it far more finely than the electrode pitch.

zh: 为什么手套不能按屏幕
触摸屏怎么知道手指在哪

description.zh: 光子随机到达，数到 N 个涨落约 √N；暗处照片发花，夜景模式靠叠加多帧降低噪声。
description.en: Photons arrive at random, so a count of N fluctuates by about √N; night mode stacks frames to beat it down.

zh: 为什么夜景照片有噪点

title.zh: 同色异谱：屏幕怎样骗过眼睛
title.en: Metamerism: how a screen fools the eye

description.zh: 眼睛只量三种视锥的三个数，红绿子像素一起亮就能和黄光一样；纯光谱色落在三原色色域之外。
description.en: The eye reports only three cone signals, so red plus green sub-pixels match yellow light; pure spectral colours lie outside the RGB gamut.

zh: 光的混合和颜料的混合
三原色能混出所有颜色
en: why red and green make yellow

title.zh: 压缩：只存猜不中的部分

description.zh: 先预测再存残差，图像越好猜文件越小；噪声猜不中，所以暗光照片文件更大。
description.en: Predict each pixel and store the residual: predictable images are small, and noise cannot be compressed away.

zh: 为什么天空照片文件小
en: why is a sky photo small

description.zh: 信号随距离按幂律衰减，速率上限 B·log₂(1+S/N)；小区边缘缺的是信噪比，加宽带宽帮不上忙。
description.en: Signal power falls as a power of distance and capacity is B·log₂(1+S/N); at the cell edge you lack signal-to-noise, not bandwidth.

title.zh: 汉明码：多发三个比特改正一个错
title.en: Hamming code: three extra bits fix one error

description.zh: 三个互相重叠的校验位，失败的组合指向翻错的那一位；两个错同时出现就会改错。
description.en: Three overlapping parity checks point to the flipped bit; two simultaneous errors get mis-corrected.

zh: 信号不好为什么还能通话

description.zh: 新基站要强出一截余量才切换，挡住阴影衰落造成的来回乱跳；余量太大又会守着弱基站。
description.en: A phone switches cells only when the new one is stronger by a margin, which stops noise-driven ping-pong; too big a margin keeps it on a weak cell.

zh: 坐车打电话为什么会掉线
en: how does a call find my phone

title.zh: 电池内阻：电量为什么会跳
title.en: Battery internal resistance: why the percentage jumps

description.zh: 端电压 = 开路电压 − I·R；冷天内阻变大，大电流下提前跌破关机电压，暖和后又“回来”。
description.en: Terminal voltage is open-circuit voltage minus I·R; cold raises R, so a heavy load hits the cutoff early and the charge 'returns' when warm.

zh: 冬天手机为什么自动关机
en: why does my phone die in the cold
why does fast charging get hot

title.zh: 看懂任何设备的三个问题

description.zh: 它量的是哪个很小的量？噪声是什么？用什么办法把两者分开？附一张手机常见现象的排查表。
description.en: What tiny quantity does it measure, what is the noise, and what trick separates them? With a table of everyday phone symptoms.

label.zh: 用 GPS 定位重置漂移

reason.zh: 第 2 章的漂移模型可以每秒接收一次第 1 章的 GPS 定位来重置位置与速度：不校正时 60 秒漂出约 36 米，校正后约 2 米。
reason.en: Chapter 2’s drift model can take chapter 1’s GPS fix once a second to reset position and velocity: uncorrected it drifts about 36 m in 60 s, corrected about 2 m.

reason.zh: 第 6 章的噪声滑块就是第 4 章的相机噪声：噪声猜不中，干净天空每像素 0.47 位，加噪声 σ = 4 后 4.54 位。
reason.en: Chapter 6’s noise slider is chapter 4’s camera noise: noise cannot be predicted, so a clean sky costs 0.47 bits per pixel and 4.54 bits at noise σ = 4.

label.en: Bit errors at the cell edge

reason.zh: 第 8 章从第 7 章的小区边缘出发：信噪比低的地方比特会翻转，多发三个校验位就能改正任一位错。
reason.en: Chapter 8 starts at chapter 7’s cell edge: where the signal-to-noise ratio is low bits flip, and three extra check bits correct any single flipped bit.

label.zh: 信号用第 7 章的衰减模型

reason.zh: 第 9 章两座基站的信号直接用第 7 章的路径损耗模型（n = 3.5）加阴影衰落；切换余量决定乒乓切换与迟钝切换的取舍。
reason.en: Chapter 9 takes both base stations’ signals from chapter 7’s path-loss model (n = 3.5) plus shadow fading; the handover margin trades ping-pong against late handovers.

label.zh: 卫星钟每天快约 38 微秒
label.en: Satellite clocks gain about 38 µs a day

reason.zh: 第 1 章用相对论页的光钟说明速度让卫星钟每天慢 7.2 微秒，引力又让它快 45.7 微秒，净快 38.5 微秒，光在其间走 11.5 公里。
reason.en: Chapter 1 uses the light clock of Special Relativity: speed slows a satellite clock by 7.2 µs a day and weaker gravity speeds it up by 45.7 µs, net 38.5 µs, during which light travels 11.5 km.

label.en: The orbit radius sets the clock offset

reason.zh: 第 1 章用万有引力与轨道算卫星速度与所在引力势（半长轴 26 560 公里，约 11 小时 58 分一圈），两项相对论修正都由它们决定。
reason.en: Chapter 1 uses Gravity and Orbits for the satellite’s speed and gravitational potential (semi-major axis 26,560 km, one orbit in about 11 h 58 min); both relativistic corrections follow from them.

label.en: The bathroom scale in a lift

reason.zh: 第 2 章引用牛顿运动定律页的电梯一步：加速度计读的是弹簧托住硅块的力，静止时读出重力，自由落体时读出零。
reason.en: Chapter 2 cites the lift step of Newton’s Laws of Motion: an accelerometer reads the spring force holding its silicon mass, so at rest it reads gravity and in free fall it reads zero.

label.zh: 积分两次，偏差变成 ½bt²
label.en: Integrate twice and a bias becomes ½bt²

reason.zh: 第 2 章引用定积分页的 v–t 图：加速度积分成速度、再积分成位移，恒定偏差 b 变成 ½bt²，0.02 m/s² 在 60 秒后约 36 米。
reason.en: Chapter 2 cites the v–t graph of the Definite Integral: acceleration integrates to velocity and again to position, so a constant bias b becomes ½bt², about 36 m after 60 s at 0.02 m/s².

reason.zh: 第 2 章说明它用的“定位一到就重置”是最粗的融合，真实手机用卡尔曼滤波的预测与更新来合并积分与 GPS。
reason.en: Chapter 2 notes that resetting on each fix is the crudest fusion; real phones combine integration and GPS with the Kalman filter’s predict-and-update.

reason.zh: 第 4 章引用泊松过程里窗口中的到达个数：光子随机到达，数到 N 个时涨落约 √N，所以暗处每像素光子少、噪声比例大。
reason.en: Chapter 4 cites the arrivals-in-a-window step of the Poisson Process: photons arrive at random, so counting N of them fluctuates by about √N, and dim pixels with few photons are noisy.

label.zh: 叠加 n 帧，噪声降 √n
label.en: Stack n frames, noise falls by √n

reason.zh: 第 4 章引用中心极限定理的精度代价：叠加 16 帧把单帧 39.5% 的噪声降到 9.9%，像素边长加倍等于叠 4 帧。
reason.en: Chapter 4 cites the precision cost in the Central Limit Theorem: stacking 16 frames cuts single-frame noise of 39.5% to 9.9%, and doubling the pixel side equals stacking 4 frames.

label.zh: 每像素位数就是残差的熵
label.en: Bits per pixel are the residual’s entropy

reason.zh: 第 6 章引用熵页的熵工坊与哈夫曼编码：能压多小取决于多好猜，预测残差的熵就是每像素至少要花的位数。
reason.en: Chapter 6 cites the entropy workshop and Huffman coding of the Entropy page: how small a file gets depends on how predictable it is, and the residual’s entropy is the bits per pixel it needs at least.

reason.zh: 第 7 章引用调制与频移页的 AM 一步和 FM 抗噪：数据搬到载波上传送，能传多快的上限只看带宽与信噪比。
reason.en: Chapter 7 cites the AM step of Modulation and how FM resists noise: data rides on a carrier, and the ceiling on its rate depends only on bandwidth and signal-to-noise ratio.

reason.zh: 第 9 章引用信号检测里判据的取舍：切换余量设低，噪声引起乒乓切换；设高，切换来得太晚，和检测判据的漏报与误报之争相同。
reason.en: Chapter 9 cites choosing a criterion in signal detection: a low handover margin lets noise cause ping-pong handovers, a high one makes them late, the same trade-off as misses against false alarms.

label.zh: 端电压 = 开路电压 − IR

reason.zh: 第 10 章引用欧姆定律页的负载一步：电池内阻上的压降随电流增加，冷天内阻变大，大电流下端电压提前跌破关机电压。
reason.en: Chapter 10 cites the load step of Ohm’s Law: the drop across the battery’s internal resistance grows with current; cold raises the resistance, so at high current the voltage hits cut-off early.

label.en: The chemistry of a discharging cell

reason.zh: 第 10 章引用电化学的放电：开路电压来自电极反应，随剩余电量下降；内阻和温度决定实际能用出多少。
reason.en: Chapter 10 cites discharge in Electrochemistry: the open-circuit voltage comes from the electrode reactions and falls with charge; internal resistance and temperature decide how much can actually be drawn.
